meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入关键词，自动开启代理的专注工作模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常和 AI 助手协作，希望一个关键词就能让它进入更深度的处理
copy.tagline_en: Type a keyword to automatically activate a focused working mode in your agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use an AI agent and want a keyword to switch into a deeper mode

howto.what: 当输入里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时，Claude 会进入严格编码模式：先显示“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”，再记录记忆、先写失败测试再实现、按任务轻重分级处理，并用真实环境证据验证结果。
howto.when: 当输入中出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发，技能会把指令注入对话，Claude 随即按该模式工作；指令已在对话中时不会重复读取。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式，修复登录接口的 500 错误
say.note: Claude 会先登记目标并写失败测试，再修复并验证。

say.text: 用 ulw 模式给订单模块加一个导出功能
say.note: 会按 HEAVY 流程处理，包含边界测试和真实环境验证。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式为这个 bug 先写一个失败测试
say.note: 它会先建立失败证明，再实现让测试转绿。

howto.what_en: When triggered by 'ultrawork' or 'ulw', Claude runs a strict coding workflow: prints 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', records memory, writes failing tests first, sizes the task (LIGHT/HEAVY), and verifies against real surfaces.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user's prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw' (or requests the mode); the directive is injected ahead of the user text. If already present in conversation, the file is not read again.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix the 500 error on login.
say_en.note: Claude registers the goal, writes a failing test, then fixes and verifies.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode to add an export feature to orders.
say_en.note: Follows the HEAVY flow with edge tests and real-surface QA.

say_en.text: In ultrawork mode, write a failing test for this bug first.
say_en.note: It captures the red proof before implementing to green.
